name: Co-Extensive Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Spouse or dependent unmarried child (under 18 for a new grant; under 21 on extension) of a Fiji permit holder.

outcome.duration_length: co-extensive with (matches) the principal permit holder's permit duration

sources.title: Department of Immigration, Fiji -- Co-Extensive Residence Permit: covers spouse and dependent unmarried children of a permit holder, fee FJD 650.05 (international) / FJD 185 (regional), processing approximately 21 working days

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Fiji). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- tier-1 Department of Immigration sourced. A separate 'Residence Permit on Special Purpose to Reside with Family Member' also exists as a distinct family-reunification instrument, but its page content was too thin to model independently -- disclosed rather than built as its own file. Fiji also grants statutory PERMIT-EXEMPT status (not modeled here, since it's an exemption rather than a permit) to spouses and children of Fiji citizens and to family members of exempted persons -- see the Fiji Permits index. work_rights set to 'none' since this is a dependent-status permit distinct from the principal's own work authorization.
